topography.project_purpose: Decentralized Euro is a collateralized debt position (CDP) protocol that allows users to mint a euro-pegged stablecoin (dEURO) against various crypto assets. It also provides savings vaults, cross-chain bridges, and governance tokens to manage the system.
topography.relationship_narrative: The Decentralized Euro family forms the core CDP, with MintingHub and PositionFactory managing vaults, while SavingsVault and SavingsGateway handle yield. Stablecoin bridges connect external euro stablecoins, and DEPS/nDEPS tokens provide governance across the ecosystem.
